title: Your ordinary words → expected handling
summary: “Why this project?” → show saved reason; change nothing.
body:
“Why this project?” → show saved reason; change nothing.

“This bullet is vague” → inspect that block and diagnose.

“Try another summary” → keep old version and create revision.

“Allow two pages” → policy and affected layout/checks; no factual rewrite.

“Different architecture” → record design change and affected components.

“Stop” → stop execution and preserve progress.

No special prompt syntax required. Clarify consequential ambiguity; do not require you to know internal machinery.

You inspect real results and decide acceptance. A question or technical PASS is not acceptance.

Standing communication rule: briefly state context, plan, done, why it matters and next; give a specific review ask and wait for the feedback needed for dependent work. Read rule-collaboration for the latest wording.
